rows.notes: [T094] start_year 2022 now carries an open-source quote: CnEVPost 2022-06-15 (S1) 'first production lines open Tuesday' (14 Jun 2022, i.e. the 通线 of phase 1) at the Shaoxing base; S2 same page gives the phase-1 design capacity 15 GWh/yr (design basis). Step 2022 = 15 unchanged from T003. No 2023/2024 step: no source dates phase 2/3 production before the 2025 EIA notice (T003). T003's 2025-12-30 联合通线 of phases 2+3 (30 GWh) is line commissioning, not a stated production date, so it is NOT added as a 2025 step here (the libattery page was unreadable by the fetcher, garbled encoding); T003's installed 45 stands untouched. Quotes S1/S2 were returned by the fetch tool's summary of the page, not copied by me from raw HTML: auditor should string-match.

[T094] start_year 2020 and step 2020 = 4 re-confirmed with a verbatim quote (Sina Tech 2020-07-10, S3): phase-1 factory mass-production handover on 10 Jul 2020, two HEV lines + one BEV line built, 4 GWh/yr capability (company basis via press; lines built, same figure as T054). No 2021-2025 step found: Sunwoda annual reports 2021/2023/2024/2025 (team/evidence/filings/300207_*.txt) give no per-base capacity (only company-wide shipments, e.g. 2023 power-battery shipments 11.66 GWh across all sites); a search for phase-2 production dates returned nothing site-specific (the Aug 2023 'phase 2 partly delivered' article is in T007 S40, no GWh). So the history stays a floor of 4 GWh from 2020; true 2021-25 capacity is higher but unsourced.

[T094] start_year 2023 (v1, reported) -> 2020: Gasgoo (S4, article on the phase-3 groundbreaking, early 2022; exact article date not captured) states 'the first phase of Xiamen base started production at the end of 2020'. The same article gives the phase-2 target 10 GWh/yr (groundbreaking 2 Mar 2021) and phase 3 stage 1 10 GWh 'scheduled to be operational in the first quarter of 2023' (a plan, not used). Phase 1 GWh not stated in any open page I opened (MarkLines teaser of June 2020 says the A6 plant will have 20 GWh built in two phases, split not visible), and the phase-2 production date was not found; so capacity_by_year_json is NOT changed here. The existing v1 reported JSON {"2023": 10, "2027": 60} is inconsistent with a phase 1 running since end-2020 and with 30 GWh built per Sina 2026-04-21 (S5: '目前厦门基地已建成投产30GWh'); lead should review/null it. The only dated capacity step sourced is 2026 = 30 (S5, April 2026). CONFLICT: Gasgoo says phase 1 started end-2020, v1 timeline and T004 note said 2023 for the first 10 GWh; the 2020 start is the better-sourced one.

[T094] step 2023 = 18: Asia Economy 2023-05-25 (S6) says Ochang annual battery production capacity 'will be expanded from 18 GWh to 33 GWh' (2170 line +4 GWh, 4680 line +9 GWh), i.e. 18 GWh current as of May 2023 (press basis; the article does not name LGES as the source of the figure). CONFLICT: S&P (paywalled, not cited) gave 21 GWh 'current' in Apr 2022 and Korea Herald 2022-06-13 gives 35 GWh combined after expansion by 2025 (implying ~22 pre-expansion, my inference only, not a source figure); 18 vs 21-22 unresolved, sources use different scopes (cylindrical-only vs plant). No 2024 step added: the 4680 9 GWh line started series production Aug 2024 per electrive (T010 S24b) but a ramp/cumulative 27 GWh is not sourced as such, and adding it to the 2023 figure would be a derived sum across dates. start_year not changed: no open source found for the first Ochang cell production (v1 2004 stays reported). No 2018-2022 step found.
